THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring two (2) Co-op students to join our Vancouver team. You will work directly with the founders, gaining exposure to mining terminology, complex problem spaces, and production-grade software development. While you will collaborate as a team, we are looking for two distinct skill sets: Role A: AI & Data Science Engineering Student Focus: Cost modeling, Python workflows, and Data Analysis. • Core Task: Design, implement, and refine mining cost models that feed into our core computational engine. • Data Ops: Extract, clean, and analyze complex mining datasets using Python, PostgreSQL, Excel, and AI LLM Querying. • Workflow: Turn experimental analyses into repeatable, documented workflows, and become deeply knowledgeable about the underlying mining data. Math: Apply advanced statistics to reason about complex datasets. • Role B: Full Stack Engineering Student Focus: Refactoring, System Architecture, and GUI Development. • Legacy Refactoring: Refactor our legacy expert-system Kernel from Fortran to Rust, improving modularity, testability, and performance. • Interface Development: Design, develop, and enhance in-house GUI programs using Tauri (Rust + Web Frontend). System Architecture: Contribute to the design of a scalable software ecosystem that ensures long-term extensibility. • Shared Responsibilities Both students will contribute to general engineering and operational tasks: • Security & Ops: Maintain and refine the system's security posture and development workflows. • Web Presence: Update the SIIM corporate website to better display capabilities for client outreach. • Learning: Rapidly acquire knowledge of mining terminology, the problem space we are in, and the specific software stack we run. LOGISTICS • Start Date: Monday, April 27, 2026 • End Date: Friday, August 28, 2026 • Hourly Wage: $25 Application Deadline: March 1st, 2026 • To Apply: Please submit your resume, unofficial transcript, and a cover letter. Job Requirements QUALIFICATIONS • Eligibility: Must be currently enrolled in a recognized Co-op program at a Canadian post-secondary institution and available for full-time, on-site work in Vancouver. Required Skills (Both Roles): • Languages: Proficiency in Python is required. • Communication: Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). • Mindset: A self-starter who works efficiently independently but is a team player; who can pivot and adapt to failure but be unafraid to experiment. Role-Specific Skills: • • For AI & Data Science: Proven experience in Data Analysis and Excel. • Strong grasp of calculus, statistics, and data modeling. • Understanding of AI fundamentals, including LLMs and agentic workflows. • For Full Stack: • Experience with Rust and React is highly preferred. • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and code maintainability. Experience working with legacy codebases is a bonus. • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through UBC Science Co-op Cover Letter Required?
